video_title: LIVE: Pelicans vs. Heat Pregame w/ Jamahl Mosley 10/8/2026

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Dejounte Murray out for Pelicans with right toe contusion
quotes.excerpt: Dejounte Murray will be out tonight, right toe contusion. It's precautionary more than anything.
quotes.quote: Before I get started, Dejounte Murray will be out tonight, right toe contusion. It's precautionary more than anything.
quotes.social_post: Dejounte Murray is out for tonight's game against the Heat with a right toe contusion. Jamahl Mosley noted the decision is precautionary.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Pelicans will continue experimenting with lineups before regular season
quotes.excerpt: The next two or three games will definitely keep experimenting with it, just to see what combinations look like.
quotes.quote: The next two or three games will definitely keep experimenting with it, just to see what combinations look like. Just to see how guys play off of each other, the things we're asking them to do, the different assignments that they'll have defensively. Obviously, this Miami team is unique in how they're lined up, so us being able to match some certain situations is going to be very important for us to see before we get into the regular season.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley says the Pelicans will continue experimenting with lineups over the next few games to see how different combinations play off each other before the regular season begins.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson's basketball IQ and desire to improve
quotes.excerpt: His basketball IQ, his want to continue to get better, pushing himself to that next level.
quotes.quote: Just sitting down with him and watching film, his basketball IQ, his want to continue to get better, pushing himself to that next level, being the best version that he can be. He wants to be challenged, wants to be tested. But again, his ability to show up with our guys in that locker room as well as on the court, he has a great spirit about him and he's willing and wanting to work each and every day.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley praised Zion Williamson's basketball IQ and work ethic, noting that Zion wants to be challenged and is pushing himself to reach the next level.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Pelicans prioritizing aggressive defensive identity this season
quotes.excerpt: We have to be an aggressive defensive team, a defensive team first more than anything.
quotes.quote: We have to be an aggressive defensive team, a defensive team first more than anything. This team was very good offensively, what it was capable of doing and able to do, guys to get to the free throw line, get downhill, attack the basket, push the pace. Those are things that were already in this group, but our ability to defend at a high level which will keep us in games and get us some games. And I think that's been the training camp focus, guys understanding the new system, how they need to defend, where they need to be on the floor, how they cover for one another, the communication that they have to have, turning it to a high level.
quotes.social_post: The Pelicans are prioritizing a new defensive identity this season. Jamahl Mosley says the focus in training camp has been on communication and understanding the new system to defend at a high level.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Bench support and development during training camp
quotes.excerpt: It was very great to see the bench and the support that they gave those guys.
quotes.quote: It was great that those guys came in and they really picked up on what we were asking them to do. Just proud of how they came in, but more importantly, it was very great to see the bench and the support that they gave those guys who had been busting their tails all through training camp, not necessarily playing major minutes. That's why we talk about during camp, iron sharpening iron, because those guys stepped in because they had been playing against those guys that are supposed to log major minutes and testing them every single day.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley praised the Pelicans bench for their support during training camp, highlighting the importance of iron sharpening iron as players push each other daily.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Pelicans focusing on physicality on both ends of the floor
quotes.excerpt: The talk was physicality. How physical can we be on both ends of the floor?
quotes.quote: I think we started our film session off with the communication level of physicality. The talk was physicality. How physical can we be on both ends of the floor? And obviously, understand how the game is going to be called, but you have a Miami team that's also very physical. Playing them for years, understand how Spo coaches and what they do down here, and we have to match, if not exceed, that that that physicality coming in, and that started the other night with us getting to the free throw line. Now we have to change that as well to the defensive end.
quotes.social_post: Physicality is the main focus for the Pelicans tonight. Jamahl Mosley says the team must match or exceed the physicality of the Heat on both ends of the floor.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Young players learning from veterans and earning opportunities
quotes.excerpt: Guys in their first and second years are still continuing to learn the league.
quotes.quote: Guys in their first and second years are still continuing to learn the league. And so we weren't talking about putting on their backs because they're a group of guys that they're going to come up, they're going to continue to grow. They've shown tremendous growth and they show of tremendous work ethic. But it's still time for them to continue to learn from those guys ahead of them and continue to push those guys because then when it's their opportunity, they get it because they've learned from the guys ahead of them and then they're ready to step into those moments.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley says the Pelicans' young players are continuing to grow and learn from the veterans ahead of them, ensuring they are ready when their opportunity arrives.
